```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 5)
options(knitr.kable.NA = "")
```

The benchmark pipeline (`make benchmark`, `workflow/Snakefile`, `config/config.yaml`) prepares each dataset once, fits every method to it, and scores how well each method ranks the proteins with a known change (E. coli spiked into a human background in IonStar, UPS1 spiked into yeast in CPTAC) above the unchanged ones. This vignette reads only the tables the pipeline exports to `inst/extdata`.

- Scores: AUC, partial AUC up to a false positive rate of 0.1 (pAUC_10) on a 0–100 scale, all contrasts pooled, for the rankings by fold change (`log_fc`), t statistic (`t_statistic`) and p-value with the sign of the fold change (`scaled.p_value`)
- Level: `protein` (model fitted to protein abundances), `peptide` (model fitted to peptides, one result per protein), `protein + peptide` (hurdle: intensity on proteins, detection on peptides)
- FDP vs FDR: the false discovery proportion at each nominal FDR; on the diagonal the FDR is calibrated
- Proteins tested vs pAUC_5 (as in ProteoBench): each method scores only the proteins it tests, so the plot shows the partial AUC up to a false positive rate of 0.05 (x) against the number of proteins tested per contrast (y); best is top right
- Line type and point shape: solid lines and circles for the prolfqua protein models, long dashes and squares for the prolfqua peptide models (nested and hurdle), short dashes and triangles for the external tools; a method has the same colour in every plot

```{r read}
extdata <- function(name) {
  utils::read.delim(file.path("../inst/extdata", name), stringsAsFactors = FALSE, colClasses = c(tool_version = "character"))
}
scores <- extdata("benchmark_scores.tsv")
curves <- utils::read.delim("../inst/extdata/benchmark_curves.tsv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
methods <- extdata("benchmark_methods.tsv")
datasets <- utils::read.delim("../inst/extdata/benchmark_datasets.tsv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
preprocessing <- utils::read.delim("../inst/extdata/benchmark_preprocessing.tsv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

```{r method-style}
# One colour per method within its group, in config order; the groups reuse the colours and differ by line type and
# point shape
series_colours <- c("#2a78d6", "#eb6834", "#1baf7a", "#eda100", "#e87ba4", "#008300", "#6250d6")
style_groups <- data.frame(
  group = c("prolfqua protein", "prolfqua peptide", "external"),
  linetype = c("solid", "longdash", "22"),
  shape = c(16, 15, 17)
)
method_style <- methods |>
  dplyr::distinct(.data$method, .data$tool, .data$level) |>
  dplyr::mutate(group = dplyr::case_when(
    .data$tool != "prolfqua" ~ "external",
    .data$level == "protein" ~ "prolfqua protein",
    .default = "prolfqua peptide"
  )) |>
  dplyr::mutate(colour = series_colours[dplyr::row_number()], .by = "group") |>
  dplyr::left_join(style_groups, by = "group") |>
  dplyr::arrange(match(.data$group, style_groups$group))
by_method <- function(column) stats::setNames(method_style[[column]], method_style$method)
as_method <- function(x) factor(x, levels = method_style$method)
method_scales <- list(
  ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = by_method("colour")),
  ggplot2::scale_linetype_manual(values = by_method("linetype")),
  ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values = by_method("shape")),
  ggplot2::theme_bw(),
  ggplot2::theme(legend.key.width = grid::unit(2.5, "lines"))
)
# Prints a plot from inside the results = "asis" loop with its own figure height
print_with_height <- function(plot, height) {
  cat(knitr::knit_child(
    text = c(paste0("```{r, fig.height = ", height, "}"), "print(plot)", "```"),
    envir = environment(),
    quiet = TRUE
  ))
}
```

# Methods

```{r methods}
methods |>
  dplyr::select(dataset, method, tool_version, level, input, description, fit_seconds) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dataset, method) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Fitted methods; fit_seconds: wall time of the fit job (jobs ran in parallel).")
```

```{r datasets, results = "asis", fig.height = 4.5}
for (dataset_name in datasets$dataset) {
  cat("\n\n# ", dataset_name, "\n\n", datasets$description[datasets$dataset == dataset_name], "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(paste0("- ", preprocessing$step[preprocessing$dataset == dataset_name], "\n"), "\n", sep = "")
  scores |>
    dplyr::filter(.data$dataset == dataset_name, .data$contrast == "all") |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(c("AUC", "pAUC_10"), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") |>
    tidyr::unite("column", "metric", "score", sep = " / ") |>
    dplyr::select(model = "model_name", "level", "column", "value") |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "column", values_from = "value", names_sort = TRUE) |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(.data$`pAUC_10 / scaled.p_value`)) |>
    knitr::kable(digits = 1, format = "html", table.attr = "class=\"table table-condensed\"",
                 caption = paste0(dataset_name, ": all contrasts pooled, sorted by pAUC_10 of scaled.p_value.")) |>
    cat()
  dataset_curves <- dplyr::filter(curves, .data$dataset == dataset_name) |>
    dplyr::mutate(method = as_method(.data$method))
  print(
    ggplot2::ggplot(dplyr::filter(dataset_curves, .data$curve == "ROC"),
                    ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y, colour = method, linetype = method)) +
      ggplot2::geom_step() +
      ggplot2::coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 0.2)) +
      ggplot2::facet_wrap(~score) +
      ggplot2::labs(x = "false positive rate", y = "true positive rate", title = paste(dataset_name, "ROC")) +
      method_scales
  )
  dataset_scores <- dplyr::filter(scores, .data$dataset == dataset_name)
  tested <- dataset_scores |>
    dplyr::filter(.data$contrast != "all") |>
    dplyr::summarize(proteins = mean(.data$n_total), .by = c("model_name", "score"))
  pauc_5 <- dataset_scores |>
    dplyr::filter(.data$contrast == "all") |>
    dplyr::select("model_name", "score", "pAUC_5") |>
    dplyr::left_join(tested, by = c("model_name", "score")) |>
    dplyr::mutate(method = as_method(.data$model_name))
  print_with_height(
    ggplot2::ggplot(pauc_5, ggplot2::aes(x = pAUC_5, y = proteins, colour = method, shape = method)) +
      ggplot2::geom_point(size = 3) +
      ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
        ggplot2::aes(label = method),
        colour = "grey20",
        size = 3,
        segment.colour = "grey60",
        min.segment.length = 0,
        box.padding = 0.6,
        force = 6,
        max.overlaps = Inf,
        show.legend = FALSE,
        seed = 1
      ) +
      ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.15, 0.4))) +
      ggplot2::facet_wrap(~score, ncol = 1) +
      ggplot2::labs(x = "pAUC_5 (all contrasts pooled)", y = "proteins tested per contrast",
                    title = paste(dataset_name, "pAUC_5 vs proteins tested")) +
      method_scales,
    height = 11
  )
  print(
    ggplot2::ggplot(dplyr::filter(dataset_curves, .data$curve == "FDP"),
                    ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y, colour = method, linetype = method)) +
      ggplot2::geom_abline(colour = "grey60") +
      ggplot2::geom_step() +
      ggplot2::labs(x = "nominal FDR", y = "false discovery proportion", title = paste(dataset_name, "FDP vs FDR")) +
      method_scales
  )
}
```
